stem: One of the two lines in a pair of simultaneous equations is $y - 2x - 4 = 0$. Draw this line on the grid by dragging the two points onto it. Any two points on the line will do.
solution: The grid draws the line as $y = mx + c$, so make $y$ the subject first: add $2x$ and add $4$ to both sides of $y - 2x - 4 = 0$ to get $y = 2x + 4$.
Read the gradient and the y-intercept: $m = 2$ and $c = 4$, so the line crosses the y-axis at $(0, 4)$.
Find a second point: put $x = -2$ into $y = 2x + 4$ to get $y = 0$, so $(-2, 0)$ is on the line. ($(-1, 2)$ also works.)
Drag one point to $(0, 4)$ and the other to $(-2, 0)$; the live equation should read $y = 2x + 4$. Any two points on this line give the same line.

The pair meets at $(-1, 2)$, which lies on this line.
